section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale (RSE), a 10-item instrument measuring self-worth on a 4-point scale. The text reports internal consistency values for women (α = .86) and men (α = .82) in the present study, and notes that both English and German versions demonstrate adequate internal consistency and convergent validity. No study-specific demographic or outcome data is provided in this section.
